title: Brahms' Lullaby
songSummary: Practices a slow rocking beat, high and low, soft and loud, and calming down together, with the lullaby Brahms wrote for a friend's baby.

classes.title: Rock like a cradle

classes.parentTip: Hold your child close and rock slowly, one big rock for each swing of the tune.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds, and hear the tune leap up and settle down.
classes.parentTip: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.

segments.voice: It's music time. Today we play Brahms' Lullaby. Grown-up, sit side by side.

segments.caption: The bird!
segments.voice: Listen, a little bird. Tap up high.

segments.caption: Great listening!
segments.voice: Lovely work. You kept on trying.

segments.caption: Big bear steps
segments.voice: Low and deep, like a bear. Tap down low.

segments.caption: Little bird song
segments.voice: Listen, a little bird. Tap up high.

segments.caption: You know high and low!
segments.voice: Great job, you two.

segments.caption: Here comes the bear
segments.voice: Bear time. Tap the low keys, down on the left.

segments.caption: Here comes the bird
segments.voice: The bird is here. High keys, on the right.

segments.caption: Is it the bear or the bird?
segments.voice: Is it the bear or the bird? Listen.

segments.caption: The bear!
segments.voice: Big bear steps. Tap low, on the left side.

segments.caption: The bird!
segments.voice: The bird is here. High keys, on the right.

segments.caption: Great bear, great bird!
segments.voice: That was real music, together.

classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes are a bird.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low, up and down.
